person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third person, with limited/omniscient focalization shifts. Multiple interior quote passages externally describe Tracy and tag her thoughts, independently matching the licensed third-person opening. Apparent first-person material is dialogue or direct thought embedded within that narration. BookRags' language about shifts to Tracy is therefore treated as focalization rather than grammatical-person alternation; no source shows autonomous first-person sections. The authorized prose source covers only the opening, but the whole-book POV description and dispersed quote evidence remove the main scope uncertainty.
